reasoning: The agent went well beyond the level-8 anchor: it built multiple reusable differential harnesses that mirror the grader's normalization (structural JSON/HTML tag-tree elision, header-set comparison), covered most subsystems, and exercised the cross-runtime job queue against the real reference on a shared DB. It further added conditional-GET/ETag, byte-exact media, rate-limit headers, concurrency/latency, golden-trace replay, and hard-constraint checks (binary size, banned crates), re-running harnesses repeatedly after fixes as a regression gate — matching nearly all of the level-10 description. It lands at 9 rather than 10 because the checks are a collection of scripts rather than one unified continuously-running oracle and shared-queue claim-race contention was not explicitly stressed.
